text: I think I have just the thing for you! I know you're looking for something with a bit of creaminess, but also trying to cut down on saturated fat. While the Lemon Rice recipe does have a decent amount of fat, it's actually relatively balanced considering the portion size and the other ingredients. The lemon and herbs add a bright, refreshing flavor that should help offset the richness of the butter and rice. Plus, it's quick to make and should fit within your 45-minute time frame. Give it a try!
